//: Shot shapes. netClear: height above the tape at the net (m). spinRpm: + topspin, - backspin. depth: landing distance from the net as a fraction of the half. racketMax: speed of the face at the impact point (m/s) on a perfect, full swing; the ball leaves at ea v_in + (1 + ea) V along the face normal (src/sim/contact/racket.ts), so the same swing sends a harder incoming ball back faster. Set from the old ball-speed caps against a slow incoming ball (the most a player swings) (smash lowered: 137 km/h from a lob, semi-pros measured 133 km/h). impact: planned impact point from the tip (m; Viollaz: smash 83 mm, drive 128 mm, volley 146 mm). spinFloor: when the swing is short of face speed, spin goes first, down to this fraction of spinRpm (default 0.3), then pace; a chiquita is its spin. errorScale multiplies the error model. pace: hit at full speed and aimed by elevation alone (the net is just a check), as a kill smash is. sideRpm: sidespin that curves the ball towards the side it is aimed at (víbora); the launch is turned so it still lands on the target.

swing.//: Errors are made in the swing and pushed through the impact physics. Angles in degrees, contact offsets in metres on the face, all times errorScale x modifier error / control, with bad = 1 - timing quality. path: the whole swing turned (yaw, pitch); face: the face alone turned against the path (more or less open: spin and height change with it); speed: racket speed (fraction); contact: where on the face (along it from the planned point, across it from the long axis). timingYaw: degrees the swing is turned per 0.11 s early (pulled across the body) or late (pushed); timingAlong: metres the contact moves towards the tip per 0.11 s early. Too early / too late (quality < 0.2) meet the ball at least edgeMin off the axis: the edge or the frame. frame: a ball meeting the frame keeps frameSpeed of its pace (plus up to frameSpeedRand), turned at random by frameYaw and up by framePitch.
